summary.plain: Two identical tank-like detectors near and far from South Korea's Hanbit nuclear reactors, watching for antineutrinos. Data taking ran from 2011 to 2023.
summary.technical: Two identical Gd-doped liquid-scintillator antineutrino detectors at 294 m and 1383 m from the Hanbit reactor array; per-detector target mass is not sourced. Data taking ran 2011-08 to 2023-03 (3800 live days).

technology.note: The 2012 discovery paper does not itself state the detectors' liquid-scintillator technology in the abstract text consulted; classified as liquid_scintillator based on the well-established RENO/Daya-Bay-family detector design referenced generally across reactor-neutrino experiments, but no per-detector target mass was found in a source consulted.
technology.value: Two identical gadolinium-doped liquid-scintillator antineutrino detectors
